title: GAB-Outreach-Generator Output
description: Cold outreach email for a programmatic publisher partnership via Google Authorized Buyer. Raw JSON only — no markdown fences, no surrounding text.

subject_line.description: Email subject line. Specific, technical, non-clickbait. References domain or vertical. No exclamation marks. No emoji. Maximum 60 characters strongly preferred.
examples: Direct GAB demand for breakingnews.com — supply chain proposal
GAB programmatic demand for utilityapp.net monetization
Programmatic demand access for lifestyle.blog via GAB

email_body.description: Full email text including salutation and sign-off. Prose only — no bullet lists, no headers. 4–6 sentences in the body. Must contain 'Google Authorized Buyer' or 'GAB'. Must not contain: hope, great day, emoji, Dear undefined, Dear null, or any unfilled placeholder. Salutation is 'Hi [name],' when contact_name is provided, otherwise 'Hi,'.

technical_hooks_used.description: Short labels for each technical concept referenced in the email body. Minimum 2 items. Used for audit and A/B testing of messaging approaches.

items.description: Technical concept label (e.g. 'GAB direct demand', 'sellers.json compliance', 'fill rate optimization', 'CPM floor control', 'viewability optimization').

constraints.output_format: Raw JSON only. No markdown code fences. No surrounding text.
constraints.gab_required: email_body must contain 'Google Authorized Buyer' or 'GAB'.
constraints.no_emoji: Zero emoji characters in subject_line or email_body.
constraints.hook_minimum: technical_hooks_used must contain at least 2 items.
